info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Consumer Data Retrieval API
info.description: The Customer Consumer Data Retrieval API allows users to access detailed consumer data associated with a specific customer. This API is essential for businesses looking to personalize their customer interactions and enhance service delivery. By retrieving consumer information, typical consumers such as marketing teams and customer service representatives can effectively tailor offerings and improve customer satisfaction. The operation focuses on facilitating data access through a simple GET request, ensuring seamless integration into various applications and workflows.

get.summary: Retrieve consumer details for a specific customer.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed consumer information associated with a specified customer ID (CUST-100045). Use this to obtain relevant consumer data for analysis or integration into applications.
